question: When is the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer observed globally every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**16 September**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **1994**, the United Nations General Assembly proclaimed **16 September** the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer.
 
• In **1985**, the world’s governments adopted the** Vienna Convention **for the Protection of the **Ozone Layer**. 
 
• Under the Convention's **Montreal Protocol,** governments, scientists, and industry worked together to cut out **99 per cent** of all ozone-depleting substances.
 
• The theme for the 2022 edition is- **Montreal Protocol@35: global cooperation protecting life on earth**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Organ Donation** Day celebrated on** 27** November
 
• **Rajasthan foundation** day every year celebrated on **30** March
 
• **World Wetland** day is celebrated on** 2 **February.
